_comment: Mutations that break the two fixes of PR #44 round 2.
F1: the Binance geo-block give-up was scoped to the WHOLE shared
request helper, so a 451 aborted the aggTrades and the
open-interest paths after ONE request -- two endpoints that have
NO archive fallback to get to, and whose five tries were the only
chance to get through a flapping block.  The give-up belongs to the
klines path alone, because the klines path is the one with the
F2: the coverage note was computed by the loader and read by TWO
hand-picked call sites, so the trainer, the data consumer, the
diagnostics routes, the API and the celery paths could all
receive a shortened, hole-riddled archive frame with nothing
saying so.  The note has to travel WITH THE FRAME.
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.
A mutant is KILLED when the pytest run of the target files reports a
failure or an error.  A SKIP (needle not found) is NOT a kill: the

mutations.label: F1-A: the geo-block give-up is back on the shared path, so EVERY endpoint gives up after one request
F1-B: the klines path loses the give-up, so it spends the five tries before the archive answers
mutations.needle:
if endpoint in _ENDPOINTS_WITH_ARCHIVE_FALLBACK:
        return _make_api_request_giveup_on_geo_block(endpoint, params, market_type)
mutations.replace:
if endpoint in _ENDPOINTS_WITH_ARCHIVE_FALLBACK:
        return _make_api_request_with_retry_budget(endpoint, params, market_type)

mutations.label: F1-C: the give-up is attached to the WRONG caller (aggTrades is declared to have a fallback)
F2-A: the coverage note is never attached to the frame
mutations.needle:
note = klines_window_coverage(frame)
    if note:
        frame.attrs[COVERAGE_ATTR] = note
    return frame
mutations.replace: return frame  # MUTANT: the note is never attached to the frame

mutations.label: F2-B: the frame the loader returns does not carry the note
mutations.replace: pass  # MUTANT: the note is not attached to the returned frame

mutations.label: F2-C: the cache-only frame does not carry the note
mutations.replace: pass  # MUTANT: the note is not attached to the cached frame

mutations.label: F2-D: the coverage key is renamed, so the note cannot be read by name
mutations.replace: COVERAGE_ATTR = "klines_window_coverage_renamed"  # MUTANT: the key cannot be read

mutations.label: F2-E: the provenance key is renamed, so the coverage cannot be computed at all
mutations.replace: PROVENANCE_ATTR = "klines_provenance_renamed"  # MUTANT: the key cannot be read

mutations.label: F2-F: the trainer stops logging the window it did not get (the process path)
